s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of unilateral weakness, speech disturbance, and visual disturbance with a history of cardiac arrhythmia and pacemaker implantation
salient_findings: Gaze deviation in the right eye
key_facts: Patient is a man in his 70s
Presented to the emergency department
Has a history of permanent atrial fibrillation
Has a history of complete heart block
Has a pacemaker implanted in the late 1990s
Pacemaker was upgraded to a biventricular system
Blood pressure was 147/75 mm Hg
Heart rate was 84 beats per minute
Respiratory rate was 16 breaths per minute
Oxygen saturation was 99% on room air
Computed tomography angiography showed a large middle cerebral artery territory

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of unilateral weakness, speech disturbance, and visual disturbance with a history of cardiac arrhythmia and pacemaker implantation
salient_findings: Gaze deviation in the right eye
key_facts: Patient is a man in his 70s
Presented to the emergency department
Has a history of permanent atrial fibrillation
Has a history of complete heart block
Has a pacemaker implanted in the late 1990s
Pacemaker was upgraded to a biventricular system
Blood pressure was 147/75 mm Hg
Heart rate was 84 beats per minute
Respiratory rate was 16 breaths per minute
Oxygen saturation was 99% on room air
Computed tomography angiography showed a large middle cerebral artery territory

differentials: Hereditary endotheliopathy with retinopathy, nephropathy, and stroke
per_call: Hereditary endotheliopathy with retinopathy, nephropathy, and stroke

shortlist.label: Ischemic stroke
shortlist.why_kept: Patient presented with left-sided hemiparesis, dysarthria, and gaze deviation, consistent with ischemic stroke symptoms

shortlist.label: Cardioembolic stroke
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a history of permanent atrial fibrillation, which increases the risk of cardioembolic stroke

shortlist.label: Middle cerebral artery occlusion
shortlist.why_kept: Computed tomography angiography showed a large middle cerebral artery territory, suggesting occlusion

shortlist.label: Atrial fibrillation-related stroke
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's history of atrial fibrillation and presentation with stroke symptoms suggest a possible link

shortlist.label: Thrombotic stroke
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's pacemaker and history of cardiac arrhythmia increase the risk of thrombotic stroke

raw.rationale: The patient's history of permanent atrial fibrillation and the presence of a large middle cerebral artery territory on computed tomography angiography suggest a cardioembolic source of the stroke, which is consistent with the patient's symptoms of left-sided hemiparesis, dysarthria, and gaze deviation.

rejected.label: Ischemic stroke
rejected.why: Too broad, as it does not specify the embolic source

rejected.label: Middle cerebral artery occlusion
rejected.why: Describes the location of the occlusion but not the underlying cause

rejected.label: Atrial fibrillation-related stroke
rejected.why: Similar to cardioembolic stroke but less specific to the embolic mechanism

rejected.label: Thrombotic stroke
rejected.why: Less likely given the patient's history of atrial fibrillation, which increases the risk of cardioembolic stroke
